No `!`, no `(narrowing)`: no dogfood battery owed. | | Scope | 26 files; 25 inside the claim surface: `section-nav-context.ts` (new), `form.tsx` (+140/−4), the new components test, `components/src/index.ts` (+5: a 3-line comment, one value export, one type export), `FormSectionNav.tsx` (+ test, new), `ModalForm.tsx` / `ObjectForm.tsx` (mounts only), five existing plugin-form tests, 11 locale files, the changeset. | | Clause-② / Metadata-protocol | Body, changeset and claim carry the same lines: `yes (widening — one @object-ui/components export + new @object-ui/i18n locale keys; no FormSchema or spec key)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. No spec, FormSchema or view key is touched. Nothing is renamed or removed. | | Changeset | Names `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/i18n`, the three published packages whose `src` moved (`@object-ui/app-shell` is private and only its test moved). Sentences read against the diff:
• "one entry per visible section between the title and the scrolling body" = `ModalForm` draws `` between `DialogHeader` and the `overflow-y-auto` body.
• "full-page sectioned form … above its sections, sticky" = `ObjectForm` `sticky top-0 z-10`.

• "each heading row now carries a stable `id` and a `data-form-section` attribute" = `SectionDivider id={anchorId} data-form-section={sectionKey}`, with `anchorId` from `sectionAnchorId(React.useId(), name)`, so two forms on one page do not collide.
All true. | | Nested forms | The renderer provides `null` to its own descendants (`FormSectionNavContext.Provider value={null}`), so an inner form never reports into the outer sink; pinned, and ablation 3 turns that pin red. Unmount reports `null`. | | Existing-test edits | Six tests now read section names `within(form)` because the strip repeats the names. No hardcoded user text otherwise (the `· N` count is `aria-hidden`; the sr-only text is translated). | | Docs | Searched `content/docs` and `skills` for statements about the stacked layout, section headings, navigation and long forms. `layout-dsl.mdx:238` and `:1086` recommend `tabbed` for collecting a long form "in stages", which stays true. `views.mdx:470-474` ("`simple` — Single-page form") stays true. Nothing is made false. | | Acceptance | 1–3 pinned in `FormSectionNav.test.tsx` and read in a browser (PR body). The footer missing-required hint is not in the card's acceptance; see Notes 2. | | Tests | Real commands with output: 424 files / 5113 tests passed on this head under the verify lock; 7 + 7 new pins; three ablations, each restored to an empty `git diff HEAD`. 40 derived gates run, one red then fixed and re-run. | | Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34642`: NOT governed, 0 of 26 paths, 891 lines. Tier S, lands through o3-B. | | CI on this head | 58 check-runs: all `success` or `skipped`. Test UI 16/16 shards plus the aggregate, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset, Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are all `success`. | ### Notes 1. **L2 for the components export (seat).** The seat delegated locale-keys-only `Clause-②: yes (widening)` declarations to L1-a. This one also adds a value export (`FormSectionNavContext`) and two types to published `@object-ui/components`, so per `contract-review.md` the export face goes to the seat for L2 at TIER_DEFAULT. The locale keys I have read and they hold. 2. **Footer missing-required hint.** Triage 6937255202 says the card "carries" it, but the acceptance does not list it; the seat agreed to leave it out. That head owes a delta read of the `ModalForm.tsx` hunks and CI on the new sha. 5. One `react-refresh/only-export-components` warning for `useFormSectionNav` exported beside the component (declared). ## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `3e9036363ca17068d84c6420e77db3adb8918205`
Local-runs: none
Scope: declaration face (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`), net diff vs merge-base `31096af83d05c28462001d7cb5e3b58e57830cb4`, all 26 files: `.changeset/34605-form-section-nav.md`, `ui/packages/components/src/index.ts`, `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/section-nav-context.ts`, `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*` (11), `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/FormSectionNav.tsx`, `ModalForm.tsx`, `ObjectForm.tsx`, the two new test files and the seven re-scoped existing tests; read against card #34605 (body plus comments 6937255202, 6937400927, 6938585401, 6939145003) and the 58 check-runs on the head
Security-touching: no

### ① Derived judgments

Public-surface changes the diff publishes, each judged:

- **`@object-ui/components`: `FormSectionNavContext` (value) plus types `FormSectionNavItem` and `FormSectionNavSink`. Right.** They are exported from `src/index.ts`, next to `SuggestedFieldsContext`. The package's `exports` map has `"."` pointing at `dist/index.{js,d.ts,umd.cjs}`, and its `publishConfig.access` is `public`, so all three are published and reachable. The change is add-only: no export is removed or renamed, and `SectionDivider`, `sectionKeyByFieldName`, `sectionAnchorId` and `SectionNavReporter` stay module-private.
- **The default is safe. Right.** The context is created with a `null` default value, typed `FormSectionNavSink | null`. Without a provider the renderer:
  - does not mount `SectionNavReporter`;
  - leaves `sectionNavItems` as `null` and never reads `form.formState.errors`, so it adds no RHF subscription and no extra re-renders.

  The stacked field list is now rendered before the `return`, as `stackedFieldBlocks`, instead of inline. I checked that this is equivalent:
  - `drawsStackedFields = !schema.children && !fieldTabGroups && !fieldPaneGroups` matches the ternary's last arm. `visibleFieldTabGroups` is non-null exactly when `fieldTabGroups` is, so the arm `fieldTabGroups && visibleFieldTabGroups` adds no gap.
  - `renderFormField` reads nothing that is declared later (the props destructure), so the move has no TDZ hazard.
- **Heading rows gain `id`, `data-form-section` and `scroll-mt-2` on every form, with or without a provider. Right (additive DOM).** The `id` comes from `useId` plus the URI-encoded section key, so it is unique per form instance and always a valid id. It is a host-readable attribute, not authorable metadata. See N2 for how the PR body describes it.
- **The renderer provides `null` to its own descendants. Right.** A nested sub-form cannot write into the host's sink. This is pinned by "keeps a form nested in another out of the host sink", and the PR's ablation 3 turns that test red.
- **Reporting semantics match the type's jsdoc. Right.**
  - It reports only the headings it actually drew (`nodes[j] != null`), so a `visibleWhen`-hidden section is absent (ablation 1).
  - It reports `null` for flat, tabbed or paned layouts, and on unmount.
  - The report is deduplicated by a signature, and `setItems` is stable, so the effect cannot loop.
  - `expand` reads the latest row state through a ref.
- **Error counts. Right for the card's acceptance.** They map top-level `formState.errors` keys through the divider membership, which is the same reading as `splitAtUntitledRuns`. A headingless run counts toward no entry.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`: new keys `form.sectionNav` and `form.sectionNavErrors` in all 11 locales (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant). Right.** They are add-only, and no existing key changes. `{{number}}` rather than `{{count}}` avoids i18next plural resolution. The fallback table in `FormSectionNav.tsx` matches the `en` values byte for byte.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-form`: no new export.** `FormSectionNav` and `useFormSectionNav` are not re-exported from `src/index.tsx`. The change is behaviour only: `ModalForm` (the plain dialog branch, not the subform branch, which returns earlier) and `SimpleObjectForm` now provide the sink and draw the strip. **Right.** It matches the claim's surface, the card's "Reader" line, and card items 1–5.
- **Accept-set (metadata). Unchanged. Right.** No `packages/spec`, FormSchema, view or section key is touched, and nothing is configurable, as card item 5 requires. Leaving out the paned layout is consistent with the card's tab and wizard exclusion: paned has its own group switcher.
- **The re-scoped existing tests do not weaken any assertion. Right.** Each `getByText` on a section name is narrowed to `within(form)`. That form reading is still the readiness signal, and the hidden-heading control still asserts absence inside the form.
- **Gates: 45 success, 13 skipped (path-filtered or opt-in), 0 failure, 0 pending check-runs on the head.** The skipped runs include "Check Changeset", which is green, "Type Check UI", "Test UI" (16/16 shards), "Lint UI" and "Live E2E UI".

### ② Semver level

- **The changeset is `patch` on `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/i18n`. Correct.** Under AGENTS.md (Working rules, changeset item), the level follows the Metadata-protocol kind alone: `none` takes `patch`, and a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right, because the diff adds nothing a metadata author can write. All three packages publish a change, so all three need the entry. `plugin-form` changes behaviour only, but it still needs one. No package is left out.
- **The `Clause-②:` line reads `yes (widening — one @object-ui/components export + new @object-ui/i18n locale keys; no FormSchema or spec key)` in both the PR body and the changeset, and the two are identical.** The arm `(widening)` is correct: the diff is add-only, with nothing narrowed. The changeset body names all three symbols and both keys, and says "Nothing that worked before is refused". The card's claim amendment 6939145003 names the same three symbols.
- **N1 (nit):** "one @object-ui/components export" undercounts. The diff exports one value and two types. The changeset body and the amendment name all three, so no reader is misled. Spelling it as "one context export plus its two types" would read exactly.

### ③ Boundary flags

The os-dev-report's `open_questions` is `[]`. Each of its deviations is answered here:

1. **Surface widened to `components/src/index.ts` and the app-shell DataPillar test.** Answered. `index.ts` was already in claim 6937400927. The DataPillar test is added by claim amendment 6939145003 on the card. The edit is test-only and scoped correctly.
2. **Footer missing-required hint not implemented.** Answered, no finding against this PR. The card body (要做的 1–5, 验收 1–3) asks for the per-section count on the strip and nothing in a footer. Only triage comment 6937255202 mentions a footer hint, and the claim's `Premise:` line records it as out of scope. **Escalated to the seat:** if the footer hint is still wanted, it needs its own card. That is not a defect of this head.
3. **Six existing tests re-scoped.** Answered. I verified it in ①: no assertion is weakened, and the counts match. The six are ObjectForm, formViewTabKeys-26843, sectionLabelI18n, sectionVisibleWhen-6111, sectionedFormValues and DataPillar-30057.
4. **The Studio form-view Preview now shows the strip.** Answered. The preview renders the runtime dialog, so the strip mirroring the runtime is the intended result. It changes nothing in metadata or the contract.
5. **Draft PR, no reviewer requested.** Process only, not a contract question. n/a.
6. **One `react-refresh/only-export-components` warning.** It is a warning, not an error, and "Lint UI" and "Lint · ESLint" are green. **N3 (nit):** moving `useFormSectionNav` into its own module would clear the warning. It is optional.

Other checks:

- **SQL push-down (AGENTS.md Prime Directive 5): n/a.** This is client-side UI only. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join.
- **Security: none.** No hunk touches permission, sharing, credential, token or auth behaviour. The neighbouring `deniedDescription` i18n key is unchanged context.
- **N2 (nit):** The PR body's "No sink: nothing changes, and `formState.errors` is not subscribed" is true of the report path. However, every section heading row now carries `id`, `data-form-section` and `scroll-mt-2` whether or not a sink is provided. The same paragraph and the changeset ("each heading row now carries a stable `id` and a `data-form-section` attribute") already say so, so this is wording only. It is additive, and no existing selector is affected.

No must-fix, no should-fix. Nits: N1, N2, N3.

**VERDICT: PASS**
